messages:
maria: Heads-up: thinking about a small UX for console analytics — 'snapshots' that capture the full per-route/per-model filter state and emit a deep link you can paste in a ticket. would make root-causing regressions way faster.

aj: :eyes: are you thinking team-shared or personal bookmarks? scope/visibility is the tricky bit.

maria: team-shared by default, but with controls. idea: snapshot = routeId + modelId + queryDSL + time-window + UI flags (compare mode, pinned metrics). deep link = /console/route/<id>?snap=<token>. open link restores state.

sasha: love it. can we also include a lightweight preview (small inline card) that shows the key metrics (p50, error-rate delta) so ppl know what they'll open? reduces noise in tickets.

kevin: backend concerns: storing full queryDSL for every snapshot could get expensive. do we plan to expire snapshots? also need to think about mutability when models roll out — the snapshot should be tied to model version or show a warning.

maria: yes to expiry. default = 90 days, org-admins can extend. snapshots store modelVersionId (optional). if current model differs, UI shows "snapshot model mismatch" with a diff view.

aj: about permissions: sensitive params (customer IDs, prompt text) might be in queries. we should strip or redact by default unless creator marks it sharable-with-secrets. maybe have a toggle on create.

sasha: or store an allowlist of fields to persist. UX: on snapshot creation we show a quick redaction step: check boxes for fields to include. cheers to making it explicit.

kevin: operationally, implement as: store a hashed snapshot token, minimal blob (route, model, time-range, sanitized query), and a compact preview metrics cached separately. long-term archival can be offloaded to cheaper storage. billing wise, small.

maria: sample deep-link format for discussion: `GET /console/route/12345?snap=ab12cd34&from=2026-03-15T00:00Z&to=2026-03-15T01:00Z&compare=true`. UI reads token, fetches snapshot metadata and preview, then hydrates filters clientside.

aj: UX nit: clicking a snapshot in a ticket should open a modal first (preview + open in new tab) to avoid jumpiness. also add a "copy link" action that masks sensitive fields.

sasha: analytics: track open rates, creator/org, and whether snapshot led to action (deploy/rollback). useful for product metrics and to justify feature.

kevin: one more: versioning. if a snapshot references a saved query that later changes, we should keep the snapshot immutable (store query text at creation). just link back to the saved query for edits.

maria: agreed. immutability + optional link to latest saved query. roadmap ask: small MVP — create snapshot, deep link, preview card, expiry, and admin controls. follow-ups: redaction flow, model-version mismatch UI, analytics events.

console-bot: deploybot: scheduled rollout for console snapshots feature toggles to 'internal' group at 2026-03-23T06:00Z :rocket: (info only).

aj: i'll sketch a tiny flow in figma and drop it in the #design channel. anyone want to join a 30m sync later today?

sasha: i'll join. kevin maybe for infra constraints.

kevin: yep i'll be there.

maria: thanks all — I'll create a GH issue with the MVP checklist and link the figma.
